name: tabs
description: A navigation component for switching between content sections.

tokens._iconRule: Optional leading icon (14x14, stroke-based) tracks the trigger's fg per state (Paired icon rule) — same token as the label. Never color/icon/*. Gap icon↔label: Default 6px (spacing/component/xs-plus), Line 4px (spacing/component/xs).

tabTrigger: icon (optional leading, 14x14, stroke-based) — tracks label fg per state
composition.slotRule: tab-list slots are typed and accept tab-trigger instances only.

accessibility.focusIndicator: No Figma Focus variant; focus ring handled by CSS/browser at tablist or trigger level.

constraints: Match tab-list Variant to tab-trigger Type.
Do not mix Default and Line triggers in one list.
Exactly one trigger must be Active.
Use Line for lower-weight embedded tabs.

useCases: A dashboard page has 'Overview', 'Analytics', 'Reports', and 'Settings' sections — one is visible at a time
A user profile page separates 'Activity', 'Projects', and 'Teams' into distinct tab panels
A settings page organises 'Account', 'Password', and 'Notifications' so users can jump directly to a section
A code editor shows 'index.tsx', 'styles.css', and 'types.ts' in a tab bar above the editor panel
A detail card uses line tabs to switch between 'Summary' and 'Details' without adding visual weight
An admin panel uses vertical tabs to navigate between configuration categories in the left column

Type=Default.whenToUse: Primary page-level navigation where tabs need visual weight — pill/background style

Type=Line.whenToUse: Secondary navigation inside panels, cards, or dense layouts — flat underline style

Horizontal.whenToUse: Standard left-to-right tab row — the default for most UIs

Vertical.whenToUse: Side-by-side layout where the content panel sits to the right of the tab list

comparedTo.situation: Switching between mutually exclusive sections on the same page
Expandable Q&A or stacked sections where multiple can be open
Site-level navigation to different pages or routes
Navigating between numbered pages of a dataset
Too many sections to fit in a tab row (8+)

notes: R8 reviewed 2026-05-28: fill on the tab-trigger instance root inside tab-list is intentional. State=Active prop corrected on the embedded tab-trigger in Variant=Default (H + V).

changelog.change: Added optional leading icon (14x14, stroke-based) to tab-trigger. Icon stroke follows the Paired icon rule — tracks the label's fg per state (text/secondary, surface/default/foreground, text/disabled), not color/icon/*. Rebound on all 7 variants; icon now brightens with the label in Active. Gap icon↔label: Default 6px, Line 4px (Line gap doc corrected from 2px). Verified in Figma.

darkMode.notes: No known dark mode differences — all tokens are semantic and mode-aware.
